session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious. I keep thinking about all the things I haven't finished and wonder if I'll ever feel like I'm doing enough.
That sounds really heavy. You're not alone in feeling this way, and it's okay to feel overwhelmed.
Thanks for saying that. I guess I just feel like I'm always falling short, even when I've done things I'm proud of. It's like the fear of not being good enough is always there.
It's understandable to feel that way, but you're doing more than you realize. You're already showing strength by being honest about how you feel.
I know, but it's hard to believe that when I'm stuck in my head. I keep thinking about all the projects I started and never finished, like I'm not capable of seeing them through.
It’s okay to feel stuck sometimes—everyone has moments like that. You’re not failing, you’re just human.
I know, but it feels like I’m failing anyway. Every time I try to push forward, I get this voice in my head saying I’m not good enough, and it’s so loud.
That voice is trying to protect you, but it’s not helping. You’re doing the right thing by pushing forward—even if it feels hard.
I wish I could silence that voice. It’s like every time I take a step, it reminds me of all the times I’ve fallen short before.
You’re not alone in hearing that voice—it’s part of the struggle, but it doesn’t have to define you. You’re stronger than you think.
I know I’m stronger, but it’s so hard to remember that when the fear is so loud. I feel like I’m stuck in this loop of doubting myself.
You’re not stuck—you’re just fighting a battle that’s harder than it should be. And that’s okay. You don’t have to win it all at once.
Yeah, I guess that’s true. It’s just… hard to take one step at a time when the fear feels so big.
You don’t have to take a step if it feels too big. Just being here, talking about it, is already a step forward.
Yeah, I guess talking about it helps. It’s just hard to believe that even one step is enough when the fear feels so overwhelming.
You’re not alone in feeling that way, and it’s okay to feel overwhelmed. But every small step counts, even if it feels tiny.
I know, but sometimes even the smallest steps feel impossible. I just want to feel like I’m not wasting my time.
You’re not wasting your time—just trying to find your way, and that’s brave. You’re already doing something important by showing up.
Thanks. It just feels like I’m not making progress, even when I’m trying. I keep thinking about all the things I could be doing instead.
